key_insight: A PPO-based controller can coordinate battery, hydrogen, diesel, and grid exchange to keep a hydrogen-enabled community microgrid highly reliable and profitable under uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: This work provides a practical control framework for grid-connected community microgrids that need to balance renewable utilization, resilience, emissions, and operating cost.
method: Formulate microgrid operation as an MDP with 11 state variables and 3 continuous actions.
Use PPO to dispatch battery, diesel, and hydrogen resources; grid exchange follows the residual power balance.
Evaluate PV, wind, battery, electrolyzer, hydrogen storage, fuel cell, and diesel backup over hourly operation.
evidence_signal: The model was tested on 8,760 hourly observations for a 1,000-household community in Rockhampton, Australia, achieving 99.77% load satisfaction and A$195,690.67 annual operating revenue in the normal case.
watch_item: Performance is sensitive to renewable-profile variability and training stability, and results depend on the selected accounting boundary for emissions and carbon intensity.
paper_title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy Management for Hydrogen-Enabled Community Microgrids Under Uncertainty
